title: DELTA Universal WebMCP
pitch: A human-approved WebMCP workspace that finds evidence, previews exact changes, applies project edits safely, and verifies or rolls them back.
about_excerpt: A human-approved WebMCP workspace that finds evidence, previews exact changes, applies project edits safely, and verifies or rolls them back. Like 1 Comment Story Updates Safe workspace start: Open an isolated browser copy to protect real project files while human and agent inspect shared state. Proof of Completion: Deterministic test validation and cryptographic SHA-256 proof with instant one-click rollback. Review First policy: Direct file writes are strictly blocked until a human inspects the diff and grants explicit approval. Exact Diff Preview: WebMCP agent generates atomic code and config changes without modifying actual disk files. Evidence Engine & Lock: Ranks relevant project assets with confidence scores and locks hashes to prevent stale drift. DELTA: Model-neutral shared WebMCP workspace bringing evidence, controlled autonomy, and rollback to humans and agents. DELTA — The Shared Evidence Workspace for Humans and AI Agents "Don't give your agent the whole project. Give it DELTA." 💡 Inspiration Today's coding agents are remarkably capable, yet they frequently suffer from critical real-world failure modes: Context waste & hallucination : Dumping entire repositories into an LLM context window burns tokens, misses cross-file dependencies, and invites hallucinations. The "Trust me, it's done" dilemma : Agents often declare a task finished without providing deterministic proof or a verifiable diff. Irreversible mistakes : When an agent modifies the wrong file or corrupts a configuration, reverting changes requires tedious manual Git archaeology. We asked: What if humans and AI agents worked inside the exact same visible, state-aware workspace governed by the Model Context Protocol (WebMCP)? This inspired DELTA —a model-neutral, local-first shared workspace where agents receive bounded evidence, propose atomic diffs, prove completion, and provide instant rollback. ⚙️ What It Does DELTA turns complex, mixed software projects into precise, state-aware WebMCP tools with a fail-closed human-in-the-loop workflow: Universal Safe Workspace : Users open a safe in-browser project copy. Original files remain completely untouched during exploration and planning. Evidence Engine & Evidence Lock : Rather than sending thousands of lines of code, DELTA ranks relevant files, symbols, imports, tests, and documentation with calibrated confidence. The resulting evidence set is hashed into an Evidence Lock ; if files drift, execution halts automatically. Exact Diff Preview : External AI agents call WebMCP tools ( plan_task , preview_change ) to generate atomic replacements, additions, or deletions without touching the disk. Previews render immediately in the human Review changes view. Human-Owned Autonomy : Under Review First policy, direct file mutations are strictly blocked until a human inspects the diff and grants one-time approval. Agents cannot elevate their own permissions or forge approval. Proof of Completion & 1-Click Rollback : Tasks are verified against deterministic success criteria. Semantic success generates a cryptographic SHA-256 Completion Proof . If anything is unsatisfactory, clicking Rollback restores the original state in under a second. 🛠️ How We Built It DELTA was engineered from the ground up as a high-performance, local-first web application: WebMCP Architecture : Deep implementation of the standard WebMCP specification via document.modelContext.registerTool() and executeTool() . Over 41 dynamic tool contracts adapt in real-time to the open project state (e.g., expanding from 6 discovery tools to 22 task-specific tools as a project and diff are formed). Local-First Indexing & Graph Analysis : Fast in-memory symbol, AST-like textual references, and dependency graph traversal built in modern modular JavaScript/ES modules. Zero External LLM Lock-in : DELTA does not embed an LLM; it is purely the evidence, boundary, and execution layer that any WebMCP-compatible host (OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, Claude, local agents) can seamlessly command. E2E Automation & Verification : Comprehensive regression suite powered by Playwright and Node.js test runners ensuring 100% deterministic reproducibility across browser sessions. 🥊 Challenges We Faced Dynamic Tool Registry Synchronization : Ensuring that WebMCP tool availability matches the exact current UI state (e.g., apply_change becoming available only when a preview exists, and bind_agent_native_host only when requested by a human) without race conditions. Balancing Safety and Agent Autonomy : Creating a system where agents feel natural and flexible in proposing multi-file refactors while guaranteeing that unauthorized file writes, binary corruption, and path traversal remain mathematically impossible. Designing Trustworthy Completion Proofs : Moving beyond "LLM says OK" to deterministic criterion evaluation ($\text{SHA-256}(\text{evidence} + \text{diff} + \text{tests})$) that both humans and automated evaluators can audit. 🏆 Accomplishments & Key Learnings True Model Neutrality : Demonstrated that the WebMCP layer is the operational interface, allowing any agent to perform surgical, multi-file code and configuration changes with zero secret leakage. Bounded Context Efficiency : Proved that feeding an agent a calibrated 10–20 KiB evidence slice yields higher task accuracy than dumping a 200 KiB codebase into the prompt. Reversible Peace of Mind : Building an instant rollback engine that restores complex multi-file projects back to baseline with a single click. 🚀 What's Next for DELTA Expanded Adapter Ecosystem : Introducing declarative adapter SDKs for game engines (Godot, Unreal, Unity) and complex domain formats. Multi-Agent Handoff Protocol : Broadening our integrity-checked task handoff schema so heterogeneous agents can collaborate on long-horizon engineering tasks without passing privileged credentials.
